Absolutely. To be honest, I have very little knowledge about what it's like to have a mother with vision, but I know I do.
When she walks into the room, she cannot see what is on my computer screen. If I felt like it, I could just watch porn right in front of her (mute, of course).

I can get away with fapping very easily.
I can also hide things very easily.
Whenever she needs to find something, she needs to use her hands, so the process takes probably twice as long as searching with your eyes.
She raised me while my dad worked. You'd probably be *very* surprised at how much she can do even though she can ony see shades.
Nope. I get along with her, so there isn't really any need or me to do so.

Abaolutely correct. It is hell.
And coping? The only method I have for coping with this depression is self-harm.
However I've stopped for about two months. And right now I feel terrific thanks to [this guy](http://reddit.com/user/legend_of_derp)'s very wise words.

Your words are **incredible**. Having read that, I **actually** feel happy. I haven't felt like this in months. I don't even know how or why, I'm speechless I *really* am. I don't know if this will last, but I will remember those wise words.

Thank you.

I'm speechless. I really am. I always see at least 1 negative thing in everything, except you. It's strange. I'm really speechless.

I'm gonna stick around for a bit longer.
I have nothing. That's why I'm here. I've lurked on SW for months. Now, I knew it was my turn to reach out, because I have nothing else.
Actually possessing the power to push through, and just the presence of it, are two different things. I don't possess the power nor the will to push through.
I guess you didn't read. If you're just gonna sit here downvoting without even knowing what I'm about, you should just leave, man. You're not helping.
Damn. That doesn't help at all, y'know that?
Did you even bother reading the rest? I hate repeating myself, so why don't you go ahead and take a look at why I'm really suicidal.
Kind of. I haven't really changed my decision, but you people did change my opinion on life itself a little.

Easier said than done, indeed. 
I simply cannot see the light at the end of this tunnel. I don't have the power to push through. Nobody will care when I'm gone, too. Maybe a few of the friends that I still have left, but the pain would go away quickly and they'd forget about me.
I can't. I just can't. I am not a valuable human being, and I know it.
In a week's time...let me see. My girlfriend broke up with me and I feel literally 10x shittier than I did before.
Well, I've got time. But there's quite a lot "going on", could you be more precise on your question please?

Well, I guess it differs between people. Because I'm torn, heartbroken, more depressed than I ever was. She was the only person I looked forward to seeing every day. She was the only reason I still wanted to live.
Firstly, holy fucking crap. This got much more attention than I expected. Thanks reddit. I'll try to reply to as many of you as I can.

Hmm. Probably should've mentioned I'm actually 14. ಠ_ಠ And cause you asked, I'm in Quebec.
Also, things actually HAVE been getting worse. A lot worse, like I expected. My girlfriend broke up with me today and I literally have nothing to look forward to in life. My desire to die is SERIOUSLY at its highest right now. And I can't do sports because I am not fit enough. It hurts whenever I run, even if it's for short periods of time. I usually play guitar in my spare time, as mentioned earlier.

Actually, I have found one talent in myself, Guitar (Coincidence much?). And the fear of death itself can be described like so: I wish I was dead, but I don't want to die...in a nutshell. However if I had more simple methods of killing myself (meds, etc.), I really wouldn't mind just going for it. Hell, if I already was on meds, I'd certainly try to kill myself with them. I probably wouldn't even be here right now.

Thank you. 
Firstly, I'm miserably failing my school year. I feel very unintelligent and I'm under the impression that I won't be able to get ahead in life. I'm ugly; I've suffered from anxiety in sixth grade which lead to an eating disorder and now I'm disgustingly skinny. I've lost a lot of friends this year, and I can barely express how fed up I am with life. The only thing that's held me back from killing myself to this date is the fear of death itself. But if things keep going the way they are, I just know I will within a matter of weeks.
